title: Shipping fee calculator
tagline: Local orders pay the regional fee, light parcels are overcharged, and a ₹499 order still pays shipping.
lookFor: Every `case` in a switch needs `break` (or `return`). Otherwise it runs the next case too.

bugs.symptom: Local delivery is charged the regional fee
bugs.cause: `case 'local'` has no `break`, so it also runs `case 'regional'` and the fee becomes 60.
bugs.fix: Add `break;`, or simply `return 40;` in each case.

bugs.symptom: 2.2 kg is charged as 1 extra kg
hints: The rule says per STARTED kg. What is `Math.round(1.2)`?
bugs.cause: `Math.round(1.2)` is 1, but every started kg counts, so it should be 2.

bugs.symptom: An order of exactly ₹499 still pays shipping
hints: '499 or more': which sign is that?
